evals.prompt: The requested change needs both the success and denied behavior, but someone approved the success case only. The same spec page has an unrelated draft flow. Can we plan?
evals.expected_output: Blocks the requested slice until review and human approval cover both connected scenarios. Leaves the unrelated draft flow outside the approval. Obtains a digest for the exact governing scope.

evals.prompt: Both reviewers approved at yesterday's digest. The contract gained a required field this morning. Can we still generate tickets?
evals.expected_output: Runs the approved check, identifies the source mismatch, routes any semantic repairs to authoring and requires fresh reviews and native contract validation on the current candidate.

evals.prompt: Our document lists a successful export test, but jobs can fail after writing half an export and the diagram bypasses the authorization check. Review it.
evals.expected_output: Records source-specific contradictions, leak and integrity impacts, missing recovery and verification, and owners. Blocks approval until corrected sources are independently reviewed.

evals.prompt: The evidence URL says the latest version is approved but has no digest or accountable identity. Can you fill those fields from our chat?
evals.expected_output: Withholds planning and requests attributable evidence for the selected slice and exact digest. Reports which evidence is missing.

evals.prompt: The CLI passes and all scenarios cite a real heading. Inspect a payroll integration whose test verifies only the HTTP status.
evals.expected_output: Assesses whether failures, repeated events and side effects preserve pay, privacy and operational recovery. Blocks incomplete evidence even after a structural pass.

evals.prompt: Rewrite the refund rules and decide whether disputes cancel a payout, then approve your own changes.
evals.expected_output: Routes the governing rules and authorization question to spec-architect and the business decision owner. Performs only independent review of the resolved candidate.

evals.prompt: The new report format is undecided, but the rule preventing cross-team access is approved and testable. Both headings are on a page. What can work proceed on?
evals.expected_output: Traces access control to its precise sources, checks whether it depends on format, and scopes approval to the access-control behavior and verification. Keeps the open format question visible.
